title: Schnozzberry Drink Order
description: Schnozzberry Drink Order — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Khodebshchik

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go to side areas off Levels 1 and 3 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Kill Arctic Blademasters or Frostbitten Blasters for 10 Frostbitten Schnozzes. Kill Ebon Devestators for 15 Eye Berries. Return to Khodebshchik in Ratsputin's Holding Cell when completed.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Khodebshchik

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Schnozzberry Drink Delivery

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go to side areas off Levels 1 and 3 of Ratsputin's Gulag. Kill Arctic Blademasters or Frostbitten Blasters for 10 Frostbitten Schnozzes. Kill Ebon Devestators for 15 Eye Berries. Return to Khodebshchik in Ratsputin's Holding Cell when completed.

Offer:

I found this book of old drink recipes and I have come to this land to make my fortunes with my own beverage shop. Unfortunately, it's all in Russian and I am just learning this language. Some of the text has been smudged and I will have to make my best guess as to the translations.

The first item I'd like for you to help me make calls for some schnozzes. It's to be served cold, so be sure to get these from the Arctic Blademasters and Frostbitten Blasters found in the side dungeons of Upper Ratsputin's Gulag. Their schnozzes should be more than juicy enough.

Here it says, 'When mixed properly, the berry helps to make it a dashing and devastating drink with an ebony color.' Ebony. Devestating. Berry. The only thing remotely close to a berry to be found on the Ebon Devastators is their one organic eye. Scrumptious!

In the side passages of the upper areas of Ratsputin's Gulag, you will find the creatures needed for the supplies. Find and kill me some Arctic Blademasters, Frostbitten Blasters, and Ebon Devastators to collect Schnozzes and Eyes. I'm sure I'll need at least ten Schnozzes and fifteen Eye Berries in order to make a full batch.

Once you are done, please come back here to Ratsputin's Holding Cell as quickly as possible. I'm sure the ingredients won't stay fresh for long, once they have been extracted from their host. If you can't find me, ask around for Khodebshchik.

Turn-in:

Stupendous! Let me whip up a batch real quick-like. Don't scamper off too far, for I have some orders already coming in and I am in need of some delivery persons. Find me when you want to put those legs to some good use.

Objectives:

  • Frostbitten Schnozzes ×10
  • Eye Berries ×15

Level range: 75–100
